_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::input_format#23 on a 1-element HEX8 deck. Five arms show that NUMDOF is checked in three different places. Arrays of length 2 under NUMDOF: 3 fail the input SPEC at parse time — "Candidate parameter 'ONOFF' has incorrect size" plus the same for VAL and FUNCT, under "Failed to match condition specification in section 'DESIGN SURF DIRICH CONDITIONS'". A self-consistent Dirichlet NUMDOF: 2 with length-2 arrays passes the spec (DIRI2_FAILED_THE_SPEC=0) and only then throws '2 DOFs given but 3 expected in Surface Dirichlet boundary condition' from core/fem/src/discretization/4C_fem_discretization_utils_dbc.cpp line 292. A Neumann block with the classic surplus NUMDOF: 6 exits 0 and reproduces the NUMDOF: 3 answer bit-for-bit ('is CORRECT, abs(diff)= 0.00000000000000000e+00' against the pinned 4.47909266337460053e-03 at TOLERANCE 1e-12), while a Neumann NUMDOF: 2 dies from a third site: 'Fewer functions or curves defined than the element has dofs.' in solid_3D_ele/4C_solid_3D_ele_surface_evaluate.cpp line 122. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

remove the pathology from the Dirichlet NUMDOF: 2 arm: declare the 3 DOFs the HEX8 node has. The DBC extractor throw vanishes and the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the Neumann NUMDOF: 2 arm. The surface-evaluate throw vanishes and the fixture must go red.
